_readme: Consulting offers shown on the home page. Keep 3 or 4; more dilutes the pitch. 'deliverables' should be concrete nouns a client receives, not activities.
intro: I help small and mid-sized businesses put AI to work: finding where it actually pays off, teaching your team to use it well, and building the custom web apps that tie it into how you already run. Google-certified Generative AI Leader, with ten years of shipping software and leading engineering teams. Every engagement starts with a short call to check the fit.

items.title: AI strategy & team training
items.summary: You know AI matters but not where to start. I look at how your business really runs, find the tasks where AI saves time or money, and train your people to use the right tools safely, so adoption sticks after I leave.
deliverables: An audit of your workflows with the AI opportunities ranked by payoff and effort
A step-by-step adoption roadmap, including tools, costs, and data-privacy guardrails
Hands-on workshops for your team, with playbooks they keep using afterwards

items.title: Custom web apps with AI built in
items.summary: When off-the-shelf tools don't fit, I build the app that does: client portals, internal tools, and assistants connected to your own data. The same way I build the coaching platform and event apps I run today, from first sketch to production.
deliverables: A deployed web app (React + TypeScript) shaped around your process
A secure backend with logins, role-based permissions, and automated deploys
AI features (assistants, document search, automations) with costs kept in check

items.title: Ongoing AI advisor
items.summary: A part-time AI and tech lead on call for your business. AI tools change every month; I keep you current, review what your team is building, and help you decide what to adopt next and what to skip.
deliverables: Monthly strategy sessions and a running list of what to adopt next
Reviews of vendors, tools, and AI projects before you commit budget
Mentoring for your team leads as they take ownership of AI work

items.title: Embedded & C++ engineering
items.summary: Where I come from: seven years of firmware and tooling at John Deere, then porting a major streaming app to Amazon's next-generation Fire TV. Still available for C/C++ firmware, device porting, and hardware simulators.
deliverables: Production C/C++ code with unit tests
Ports and integrations for new hardware or operating systems
